title: Receding-Horizon Policy Gradient for Polytopic Controller Synthesis
summary: We propose the Polytopic Receding-Horizon Policy Gradient (P-RHPG) algorithm for synthesizing Parallel Distributed Compensation (PDC) controllers via Tensor Product (TP) model transformation. Standard LMI-based PDC synthesis grows increasingly conservative as model fidelity improves; P-RHPG instead solves a finite-horizon integrated cost via backward-stage decomposition.
